Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum with the buying committee.

Attendees (what we heard):
- Alex Johnson (FinCo) — Product lead / internal champion
- Sara Lee (FinCo) — Economic buyer (CFO) — mentioned during call
- Procurement Team (FinCo) — procurement & legal review
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — AE
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) — Sales Eng
- Dev Patel (Redwood) — Solutions/Infra

Key decision criteria you called out:
1) End-to-end latency and predictable SLA for high-throughput customer queries
2) Data residency & audit logs (SOC 2 evidence required)
3) Clear pricing for pilot -> production and cost per 1M tokens estimate
4) Integration/ops (can we support expected qps and KV caching needs)

Procurement/security asks we captured:
- Standard vendor security questionnaire from procurement@finco.com
- SOC 2 report and architecture diagram
- Data processing agreement (DPA) language and retention options

Proposed next steps (we recommend):
1) We’ll share a 1-page post-demo summary and a draft SOW (attached).
2) Rishi to provide SOC 2 evidence link + architecture diagram and confirm pilot sizing options.
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive for the FinCo infra/security team (30–45m).
4) Align on procurement timeline — you mentioned target sign-off in early Aug.

Attachments: Redwood-PostDemo-Summary.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.docx

If any attendee or decision criteria are off, flag them and I’ll update. Otherwise, can we schedule the technical deep-dive next week? I’ve included a couple of proposed windows in a follow-up calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa — good notes, thanks. A few clarifications from our side so we’re aligned: 

1) Economic buyer: Sara Lee (CFO) — she’ll want to see clear cost estimates and expected ROI for a 3-month pilot.
2) Procurement process: Our procurement team (procurement@finco.com) will require:
   - Completed vendor security questionnaire
   - SOC 2 Type II (latest) or equivalent evidence
   - DPA and standard data handling terms
3) Decision timeline: we’re aiming to complete procurement review + legal signoff by Aug 6, with pilot start targeted ~Aug 15–20. That’s aggressive but possible if we move quickly.

Action items from our side: I’ll loop Sara on any finance-level asks and share the procurement questionnaire (will send separately). Procurement may request an architecture diagram and a contact for technical Q&A.

Also — can you confirm if Redwood offers a short-term dedicated pilot (reserved capacity) for a 2–4 week pilot? That would help surface real latency and cost numbers.

Best,

Alex — great to meet you virtually. Short answers to your asks: 

1) Pilot options: yes — we can provision a short-term Dedicated pilot (reserved capacity) for 2–4 weeks. We’ll size the pilot based on the expected qps and sample workload you share. For pilots, we offer a pilot pricing sheet (I can attach) and can limit network access to your VPC or provide a private deployment if needed.

2) Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report and architecture diagram are available. I’ll share a secure link to our SOC 2 package and a one-page infra diagram by EOD today.

3) Procurement/legal: We’ve worked with procurement teams to accept our standard DPA; if procurement has redlines, we can surface those to legal and aim for a fast turnaround. For any sensitive items we can propose an addendum rather than wholesale DPA change.

Next step from our side: I’ll attach the SOC2 evidence link and a pilot pricing outline in a separate email. Could Marissa coordinate the technical deep-dive scheduling with your infra and security folks?
